projectPolicy.trueSolarTime: optional; longitude plus equation-of-time correction; confirm when earthly-branch period changes
projectPolicy.nominalAge: target lunar year minus birth lunar year plus one; birthday ignored
projectPolicy.leapMonth: leap days 1-15 use previous month; days 16-end use next month
projectPolicy.ratHour: timeIndex 0 early rat; timeIndex 12 late rat; late rat advances the logical lunar day
projectPolicy.algorithm: iztro default based on Zi Wei Dou Shu Quan Shu; do not mix Zhongzhou mutagen/brightness tables
